title: #160 Television
prompt: Television serves many useful functions. It helps people to relax. We can learn from television, and it can also be seen as a companion for the lonely. To what extent do you agree with this? Explain why with your own experience.

promptSegments.text: We can learn from television, and it can also be seen as a companion for the lonely.
To what extent do you agree with this?
Explain why with your own experience.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first advantage of television is its ability to help people relax, offering a break from the hard work of daily life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first advantage of television is its ability to help people relax, offering a break from the hard work of daily life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, TV is a useful learning tool because many programs teach viewers about different cultures and topics.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, TV is a useful learning tool because many programs teach viewers about different cultures and topics.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Television viewing can make people feel bored and alone.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Television viewing can make people feel bored and alone.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: TV content is often not useful for learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: TV content is often not useful for learning.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Television provides mental relaxation and helps people feel happy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Television provides mental relaxation and helps people feel happy.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Television is useful for learning new things and acting as a companion.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Television is useful for learning new things and acting as a companion.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Television viewing can increase stress levels because the content can be stressful or confusing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Television viewing can increase stress levels because the content can be stressful or confusing.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Relying on television for social connection is not always helpful because it replaces real-life interaction.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Relying on television for social connection is not always helpful because it replaces real-life interaction.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
